description: This file defines the 'DefaultTypeManifestProvider' class which provides type manifest configuration logic for serialization in Orleans. It sets up well-known type IDs and allowed types for serialization purposes.

classes.name: DefaultTypeManifestProvider
classes.description: Implements type manifest provisioning and post-configuration for Orleans serialization system, including setting up well-known types.

methods.name: PostConfigure
methods.description: Clears existing type manifest providers to reset configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureInner
methods.description: Sets up well-known type IDs with corresponding types and adds allowed types for serialization.
